compiled_state.description:
## Context

Implement parent story A2-1 as one reviewable vertical slice. `last_get_pass` currently changes up to 20 binding entries per pass even when no real binding changes. Introduce `.bridge_state/get_rotation.json` as the new rotation store while dual-writing the legacy inline field during the rollout window.

## Approach

- Introduce a focused rotation module that owns fail-open sidecar load/save and accessors. Read the chronological `max(sidecar_value, legacy_inline_value)` for each Jira key and write every new stamp to both the sidecar and the legacy inline field. Dual-write is required so an interleaved old binary sees progress made by a new binary; A2-2 removes the legacy write only after its rollout gate.
- Load legacy-only state into memory. Persist the sidecar only through `BindingStore.save()`; this deliberately covers the end-of-pass save plus the write-ahead, recovery, and retirement save paths in `dispatch_one.py` and `binding_store.py`. `reconcile-check` uses `persist=False` and never reaches any save path.
- Wire `BindingStore` and `outbound_differ` to the shared accessors. Extract the existing outbound wrappers so `outbound_differ.py` remains at or below the locked 800-line cap.
- Add a `GET_ROTATION_FILE` constant in `git_adapter.py`, characterize it, and include it in the explicit local staging list and basename membership check in `reconcile_helpers.py` so both dual-written files land in one local commit.
- Update the `_store/push.py` regenerable-files docstring and cover that documentation requirement as an acceptance criterion.
- Preserve rollback: a reverted reader ignores the sidecar but sees the legacy field advanced by every new-binary pass.

## TDD / Verification

Author the behavioral oracle RED-first. Hold out the interleaved-binary, real-git staging, and CLI read-only cases from the implementer; expose only the basic dual-read happy path. The A1 no-commit regression is asserted only after rotation state is initialized and on a pass with no absent-key GETs. A pass that performs absent-key GETs is expected to advance and commit both rotation representations; claiming that such a pass makes no commit would contradict the required dual-write compatibility window.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] [code-verifiable] After rotation state is initialized, an idempotent real-repo pass with no absent-key GETs leaves all committed bridge-state files byte-identical and does not advance HEAD. Verified by an integration test in a temporary git repository.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A pass with at most 20 absent-key GETs advances the same selected Jira-key stamps in `get_rotation.json` and the legacy inline fields. Verified by an integration test.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The explicit local binding-store commit path stages and commits both changed rotation files without `git add -A`. Verified by a real-git integration test.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] An interleaved old-binary/new-binary pass sequence produces the same rotation order as the all-new sequence. Verified by an integration test that fails if new binaries do not dual-write or if lookup is first-wins rather than `max()`.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A legacy bindings store containing inline stamps only preserves its rotation order. Verified by a focused unit test.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A legacy inline-only store materializes equivalent sidecar state on its next persisted save. Verified by a focused unit test.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] `rebar reconcile-check` against a pre-migration store leaves `git status --porcelain` empty. Verified through the real CLI subprocess.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] `rebar reconcile-check` against a pre-migration store does not create `get_rotation.json`. Verified through the real CLI subprocess.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] `git_adapter.GET_ROTATION_FILE` names `.bridge_state/get_rotation.json`. Verified by the existing git-adapter characterization suite.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The regenerable-files documentation in `_store/push.py` names `get_rotation.json`. Verified by a focused characterization test.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/outbound_differ.py` remains at or below 800 lines. Verified by the repository module-size gate.

## Files

- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/binding_store.py`
- new `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/get_rotation.py`
- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/outbound_differ.py`
- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/git_adapter.py`
- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/reconcile_helpers.py`
- `src/rebar/_store/push.py` (docstring only)
- focused unit/integration/CLI tests

Estimated scope: M. Depends on closed A1 through the parent story.
